hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the template T(theta)=G0(theta)*V(theta)**2. Substitute theta=p to obtain the first member and theta=q to obtain the second member. The original expression is the sum of these two instances.
required_assumptions: Multiplication of scalar factors is commutative so V*G0*V can be written as G0*V**2.
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical terms share an identical algebraic skeleton with only the variable p/q changing. The LGG observation directly yields this template, and the instance maps are the two substitutions. This explains the AC equivalence and pattern-match relations.
